items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: With Jukkis, right? ... Here’s the first of a couple dates you did over the years with our friend Jukkis Uotila. ... Yes. This is – he called me.

ctx.x: European thing, called me, “I’m Jukkis. I’m from Finland.” Dave Samuels? Dave Friedman? Something like that?

items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We went around the Baltic to 10 countries, on the boat, playing jam sessions.

ctx.x: This is from the IASJ, Baltic cruise, 1996. We went around the Baltic to 10 countries, on the boat, playing jam sessions. He wrote a piece. That was the opening of the Danish Rhythmic Conservatory, done at the end of the tour.
